heroHeadline: BDBV Outbreak Active: 178 Cases, 52 Deaths Across DRC and Uganda
heroSubtitle: WHO declared PHEIC on 14 April 2026 for the first Bundibugyo strain outbreak in DRC. Ring vaccination underway in 5 Ituri health zones; 23% of affected area remains inaccessible due to armed groups. Cross-border cases confirmed in Bundibugyo District, Uganda.
footerNote: Data sourced from WHO Situation Reports, DRC Ministry of Health (MSANTE), Uganda Ministry of Health, CDC Emergency Operations, MSF field reports, and institutional analyses. CFR and case counts evolving.
